title: Crisp Spiced Aloo Tikki with Mint Chutney
summary: Boiled potatoes are roughly mashed with toasted cumin, garam masala, chilli, ginger, coriander and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled and shallow-fried, then served with a quick yoghurt-mint chutney.

ingredients.item: floury potatoes (such as Maris Piper or King Edward)
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.text: Boil the whole potatoes 20-30 minutes until just tender. Drain and cool 10 minutes.

steps.title: Toast the cumin
steps.text: Toast the cumin seeds in a dry pan for 30-60 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Peel and roughly mash the potatoes, then mix in the spices, ginger, chillies, coriander, breadcrumbs, cornflour, salt and lemon juice.

steps.title: Shape and chill
steps.text: Shape into 12 smooth patties 7 cm across and 1.5 cm thick and chill 20 minutes.

steps.title: Make the chutney
steps.text: Blend the mint, coriander, chilli, yoghurt, lemon juice and salt until smooth.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Shallow-fry 6 at a time over medium heat 3-4 minutes per side until deep golden. Drain and serve hot with the chutney.

tips: Leave a few small lumps in the mash for texture.
Do not move the patties until a crust has formed or they will break.
Smooth any cracks before frying so they hold together.
safety: Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: Cool quickly, cover and refrigerate within 2 hours. Eat within 3 days, reheated until piping hot (75 °C in the centre).
